entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Charles Juste de Beauvau, 2nd Prince of Craon, 2nd Prince of Craon (1754), Marshal of France (1783) was a French scholar, nobleman and general. The son of Marc de Beauvau, he was also brother of the famous Madame de Boufflers and through her uncle to the poet Stanislas de Boufflers.
